rows.title: Across PHEV 12V Auxiliary Battery Drain (Toyota RAV4 PHEV Rebadge)
rows.howToFix: Request a Toyota or Suzuki dealer to apply TSB 0095-20 firmware update and verify DC-DC ground connection (T-SB-0007-21). Use a 12V battery maintainer for parked stretches over 1 week. AGM 12V replacement around £200-£300 at independent. Symptoms typically appear at 10,000-30,000 miles per Toyota field data.

rows.title: V6 (H25A/H27A) Timing Chain Tensioner Rattle
rows.howToFix: Replace the No. 1 timing chain tensioner per the Suzuki TSB; if any wear is evident on the chain, sprockets or guides, replace the full timing chain kit (chain, sprockets, guides/dampers and tensioners) as an assembly. The job requires removing the front of the engine/timing cover and is labor-intensive (roughly 8+ hours flat-rate). Use an OEM or quality timing kit and set timing precisely to avoid valve-to-piston contact.

rows.title: Grand Vitara 3.2 V6 N32A Timing Chain Cover Gasket + Tensioner Issues
rows.howToFix: Cover gasket + tensioner refresh €600-€1,000. Full multi-chain kit (chains, tensioners, guides) €1,500-€2,800. Use 5W-30 dexos1 spec, stick to 8,000 km intervals. Severe chain skip means valve damage and rebuild.

rows.title: Occupant Classification System (OCS) Sensor Mat Failure / Unwanted Passenger Airbag Deployment (Recall 13V405000)
rows.howToFix: Under NHTSA recall 13V405000, Suzuki dealers replace the front passenger seat cushion assembly (which includes the OCS sensor mat) at no charge. Owners should check by VIN whether their vehicle was remedied and watch for an illuminated passenger airbag on/off indicator that does not match the seat occupant.

rows.title: Power Steering Pump Belt Tensioner Pulley Plastic Deterioration / Sudden Loss of Power Steering
rows.howToFix: Have the recall (Suzuki campaign #4009 / 2010 and 2018 actions) completed at a Suzuki dealer, which replaces the power steering pump drive belt tension adjuster pulley free of charge with the corrected all-metal design. Out of scope, replace the deteriorated plastic-wrapped pulley with the updated metal pulley and inspect/replace the belt.

rows.title: Premature Low-Beam Headlight Failure and Melted Headlight Connectors
rows.howToFix: Replace failed bulbs with quality H7 bulbs and inspect the socket/connector for heat damage; if the connector or pigtail is melted, replace the headlight socket/pigtail (and adapter) rather than just the bulb. Some owners upgrade to a higher-temperature ceramic connector or replace the headlight assembly. Check ground connections and the headlight circuit for high resistance.

rows.title: Vitara 1.4 BoosterJet Oil Dilution (Short-Trip Use)
rows.howToFix: Check oil monthly — note any rise above max. Take a 30-minute fully-warmed-up drive weekly to boil off fuel. Persistent dilution means oil change every 5,000 km not 10,000. Pre-2022 K14C: use API SP-rated 5W-30 (better than original SN spec). 2022+ K14D: use 0W-20 API SP per updated Suzuki spec. Severe dilution (oil level rising 5mm+) warrants injector leakage or piston-ring inspection.
